direction.camera: Guide attention with ceramic curve; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: arrange one rounded form with museum-like breathing room; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with museum spacing; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with slow arc.
direction.lighting: north-window softness; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: unglazed ceramic and plaster; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around still-life balance; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use ceramic curve,museum spacing,soft shadow,neutral field,still-life balance,slow arc as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
